主要内容: On July 24, 2019, Geospace Technologies Corporation issued a press release announcing its third quarter 2019 results and conference call schedule. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Geospace Technologies (NASDAQ: GEOS) announced it will release third quarter fiscal year 2019 financial results on August 8, 2019, after the market closes. The company has scheduled a conference call for August 9, 2019 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time (9:00 a.m. Central). U.S. participants can dial (866) 342-8591 toll-free, while international participants can dial (203) 518-9713. The conference ID is GEOSQ319. A replay of the live call will be available for approximately 60 days. The company designs and manufactures seismic instruments and equipment, primarily marketed to the oil and gas industry for hydrocarbon reservoir monitoring. It also serves other industries with vibration monitoring, border security, and geotechnical applications. The company also produces non-seismic products such as water meters, imaging equipment, and offshore cables.
